purpose: Callgrind totals of measurement/step.c (organizer image and flags) on input sets seeds 1 and 2 at 1 and 2 batch steps of 65536 walks, plain = Ir(2)-Ir(1); previous_kernel: before the last change; earlier_kernel: before the three kernel changes, at 1, 2, 4, 8, 63 and 64, anchor = Ir(64)-Ir(63). Inputs: the first 132096 generator lines (2^16 adders, 2^16 walks, 1024 spares).
kernel: step.c with p256_fused.h: fused branch-free kernels for batch_step's subtractions, products and square, pointers advanced by writeback; k_submul and k_mul2 products end in a carry-only finish below 2^256, acc canonical; the step's tests in one branch to step_rare, the previous tail out of line

per_round_fall.rule: the first two: earlier minus previous kernel's plain round, both measured, kernels that kept every branch; the third: this kernel's measured plain fall, equal to its path count, giving 1,441,782 for an anchor round with no step in step_rare and at most 154 more per step entering it (3 in the larger set's round 64; proof.md)

exactness: seed 1, organizer flags: dump and event line identical to the previous kernel's at 8 batch steps (walk_ref.py check: 0 mismatches), at 64 with DP_BITS=7, FILTER_MASK=0x3f, CAP_PERIODS=3, at 32 with DP_BITS=55, and at B=1024, ADDER_BITS 4 (600 steps: 813 long cycles, 1609 abandoned)
compiled_identity: objdump -d, organizer flags, addresses normalised: every function but batch_step and the new step_rare is identical to the previous kernel's at ADDER_BITS 16 and 24 apart from rodata address immediates and, in main, two counters' offsets in the report after the counted region. At 24, batch_step differs from 16 only in mask and shift immediates

common_path_bound.method: disassembly of the organizer-flag build; every conditional branch run once per walk
branches_per_walk: one combined test, taken only for a rare event, into step_rare: a distinguished point ((key>>24)|(x.v[1] & mask) == 0), a previous-key or anchor filter match, or in an anchor round the trail cap
